name: Visitor Entry Convert to Student
script:
if doc.status == "Converted" and not doc.student:
    student = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Student",
        "student_name": doc.visitor_name,
        "contact_number": doc.contact_number,
        "address": doc.address,
        "company": doc.company,
        "branch": doc.branch,
        "course_enrolled": doc.interested_course,
        "fee": frappe.db.get_value("Item", doc.interested_course, "standard_rate") if doc.interested_course else 0,
        "remarks": doc.remarks,
        "source_visitor": doc.name
    })
    student.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.set_value("Visitor Entry", doc.name, "student", student.name)
    frappe.msgprint(f"Student record created: {student.name}")
